predictions.rule: faith_score.verdict of down / zero and of up / zero (adversarial KL, one seed each) against the same-job W0 floor f: pass at or below 1.5 / (1 + f), fail at or above 1.5 (1 + f). Outcome 'lowered half' if down fails and up passes; 'both halves' if both fail; 'raised half' if up fails and down passes; 'neither alone' if both pass; 'inconclusive' otherwise; 'no power' if PC does not fail. Relative to zero
